items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: You remember the movie, They Shoot Horses, with Jane Fonda and Gig Young, Michael Sarazin...

ctx.x: who I was thinking about -- and it was Leon "Chu" Berry. Because he came along during that period, you know, with the Fletcher Henderson band, and the Cab Calloway Orchestra. A little later on I heard him on the radio and heard him at the theatre in Detroit. So the whole setting was in that period, the '32 period, so I just put myself in that frame of mind. And the conductor, Johnny Green, he was very surprised and happy, because it really did help put things in context. You remember the movie, They Shoot Horses,…
